projects.title: Movie Recommendation System
projects.problem: With thousands of movies available online, users struggle to find relevant titles that match their specific tastes, leading to choice paralysis.
projects.solution: Developed a content-based movie recommender system that analyzes movie metadata (genres, keywords, cast, crew, overview) to calculate text vector similarities and recommend the top 5 most relevant films.
workflow: Ingested TMDB 5000 movies and credits datasets.
Performed data cleaning and text feature extraction (converting list strings to list arrays).
Applied NLTK PorterStemmer to normalize words in tags.
Converted processed text tags to high-dimensional vectors using CountVectorizer.
Calculated pairwise cosine similarities between all movie vectors.
Built a Streamlit frontend that fetches movie posters in real-time using TMDb API.
features: Real-time visual recommendations with high-quality movie posters.
Graceful API fallback handling for missing poster images.
challenges: Handling nested, dirty, string-formatted JSON data inside TMDB columns (cast, crew, genres).
Optimizing performance to read and load a large pickled similarity matrix file (~180MB) efficiently.
futureImprovements: Adding Collaborative Filtering using user ratings to support hybrid recommendations.
Deploying the system to the cloud (Streamlit Share or Heroku).
Caching poster requests to reduce external TMDb API dependencies.

projects.title: YouTube Video RAG Chatbot
projects.problem: Extracting key insights or getting specific answers from long video lectures and tutorials is time-consuming and inefficient.
projects.solution: Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) based Question Answering system that extracts YouTube transcripts, creates vector indices, and feeds relevant video context to Google's Gemini model to produce highly accurate, context-bound responses.
workflow: Extracted transcripts from YouTube videos using YouTubeTranscriptApi.
Segmented the transcript into semantic text chunks using RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter (chunk_size=1000, chunk_overlap=200).
Generated text vector embeddings using HuggingFace's sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model.
Indexed and stored embeddings locally in a FAISS vector database.
Retrieved the top k=4 most relevant chunks matching the user's query.
Augmented a strict prompt template with retrieved context and user query.
Passed the prompt to ChatGoogleGenerativeAI (gemini-2.5-flash) to generate answers constrained strictly to the context.
features: Direct transcript download using only a YouTube Video ID.
Dense vector semantic search capable of handling conceptual questions.
Modular chain pipeline using LangChain Expression Language (LCEL).
challenges: Handling video transcripts that are disabled or unavailable in English.
Tuning chunk size and chunk overlap parameters to balance contextual relevance with prompt token limits.
futureImprovements: Creating a custom Streamlit dashboard UI for user inputs.
Adding conversation memory (history) for multi-turn chats.
Supporting source-highlighting and timestamps for retrieved video segments.
